value.title: Everything was perfect! The room was very clean, tidy, and comfortable, and the location is excellent—right in the city
value.text: Everything was perfect! The room was very clean, tidy, and comfortable, and the location is excellent—right in the city center and close to everything. The staff were extremely kind, friendly, and always helpful. I truly enjoyed my stay and would gladly come back again. Highly recommended!
